slides.title: Gifts are coming in 10 weeks. Is there room for them?
slides.sub: Make space now, a little at a time

slides.title: Keep one bag open by the door
slides.body: A donation bag that's always there. Outgrown or unused? It goes in on the way past.

slides.title: Do the kids' toys in 10 minutes
slides.body: Broken, missing pieces, outgrown. Three easy outs. Skip anything that needs a decision.

slides.title: Clear one shelf per week
slides.body: Ten weeks, ten shelves. Small enough to do on a low day.

slides.title: Drop the bag when it's full
slides.body: Put it in the car the moment it's full. A bag in the car leaves; a bag in the hall stays.

slides.title: New things need empty space to land in.
Want the whole home reset, step by step?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.

caption:

What room would you make space in first?
